dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I can't decide. Noodles or rice?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈkænt dɪˈsaɪd. ˈnuːdəlz ɔːr ˈraɪs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Are your bags heavy? I'll carry them for you.
dialogue.reading: ər jʊr ˈbæɡz ˈhɛvi? aɪl ˈkæri ðɛm fər juː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks for the offer, but I'm OK.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks fər ði ˈɔːfər, bʌt aɪm oʊˈkeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then I'll pick up our food. Sit down here.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn aɪl ˈpɪk ˈʌp aʊr ˈfuːd. ˈsɪt ˈdaʊn ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! An iced tea for me, please.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ən ˈaɪst ˈtiː fər miː, ˈpliːz.
